_README: Declares which PLAN YEAR the widget's plan data is for. Since T-017 (2026-10-02) the widget loads data/plans_<ST>_2027.json, and each of those files carries its own 'year' and 'source', which is what the widget displays, so the label cannot drift from the data. Keep this file in step anyway for anything else that reads it. The 2026 files (cms_<ST>.js, benefits_<ST>_2026.json) are kept unchanged so rollback is one revert. Built by SHIP/reference/tools/build-plan-data-2027.py (outside the repo).
